marta-sre: DeployBot created scheduled cutover for tenant=atlas-edge (Dedicated/Private) on 2025-11-12 02:00 UTC. Release artifact: release/edge-v2.3.4. Need final approvals: SLA, version pin, rollback gates, KV-cache snapshot, and canary plan.

deploybot: CUTOVER scheduled · tenant=atlas-edge · env=private · window=2025-11-12T02:00Z-04:00Z · artifact=release/edge-v2.3.4
runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/atlas-edge-cutover · CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/edge-v2.3.4 · ops-channel=#eng-releases

sam.eng: I approve the artifact pin. Staging smoke + e2e passed (green). tag: release/edge-v2.3.4. :white_check_mark:

lena.ops: Quick Q — canary size? I'd prefer 5% for 15m hold then evaluate. Also flagging KMS rotation: will there be any key rotations overlapping this window? :eyes:

raj.prod: Product ok with the timing. Confirming SLOs: P95 < 600ms target, error budget margin available. Rollback triggers (suggested):
- error_rate >= 1.5% sustained for 5 minutes
- P95 latency >= 1200ms sustained for 5 minutes
- QA regression score drop > 2% on core-sanity prompts
If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to previous artifact and open incident.

marta-sre: Proposed deployment plan:
- T0 02:00 UTC: deploy canary 5% (tenant routing)
- T0+15m: evaluate metrics, if OK bump to 10%
- T0+30m: bump to 25% and hold 30m
- T0+90m: final ramp to 100% (manual gate)
Quiet window reserved 02:00-04:00 UTC. SRE on-call: @marta-sre, Ops lead: @lena.ops.

violet-se: Release notes + evals uploaded: https://docs.redwood/releases/edge-v2.3.4.md
Key changes: quantization tweak to model runtime, batching default change, minor tokenizer patch (should not affect semantics much). QA will run prompt-sets: core-sanity, billing-flows, chat-fallbacks. Pass threshold: >=98% acceptance on core-sanity.

sam.eng: I'll run prompt evals at T-45m and post results. If QA sees >1% drift we'll hold. Plan stands: canary 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100% over ~2h with manual holds. :thumbsup:

lena.ops: Request: take KV-cache snapshot at T-30m and upload artifact. Also confirm backup routing and customer notify (AtlasEdge PM). Who owns snapshot?

alec-eng: I'll take KV snapshot at T-30m (script: tools/kv-snapshot.sh --tenant atlas-edge) and post link to S3. Will also validate restore on a staging mirror.

marta-sre: Good — add these runbook ops to the cutover checklist. Rollback command (if needed):
```
# emergency rollback to previous release
deploybot rollback --tenant atlas-edge --to release/edge-v2.3.3 --force --notify-channel #incidents
# post-rollback: run smoke tests and KV-cache integrity check
```

deploybot: RUN PLAN · tenant=atlas-edge · schedule:
- 02:00 UTC: canary deploy -> 5%
- 02:15 UTC: auto-eval + manual review
- 02:30 UTC: ramp -> 10%
- 03:00 UTC: ramp -> 25% and 30m hold
- 03:30 UTC: final ramp decision (manual) -> 100%
Monitors: errors, latency P95, QA regression, keyspace miss spikes. Auto-rollback disabled (manual gate required) per request.

raj.prod: Approving rollout from product 👍 — I'll be standing by on quick rollback comms if anything odd shows up.

marta-sre: All right — consensus captured. Next steps:
- @alec-eng: KV snapshot T-30m
- @sam.eng: run prompt evals T-45m and post results
- @violet-se: QA on two prompt-sets pre-cutover and immediate post-canary run
- @lena.ops: customer PM notification and quiet-window coord
If everyone agrees, I'll mark the cutover pinned and leave the manual gates in place. :lock:

lena.ops: I confirm ops readiness, customer notified, quiet window acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

sam.eng: Done — will post eval outputs at 01:15 UTC.

marta-sre: Final approval noted — marking pinned version and lock in the schedule. If anything changes please update this thread. Open incident channel will be #incidents/atlas-edge-cutover on go/no-go.

raj.prod: Thanks all. Good luck. :rocket:
